verdict.rationale: Galileo is a SaaS evaluation and observability platform, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for agents is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents API key creation, permission scoping, or per-agent credentials. The only 'scoped' mention covers project-scoped metrics, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
